content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: High error rate detected — api-gateway (edge) in us-west-2 returning 502/504s. Alert group: gateway-5xx-spike. Pager: anna-oncall.

anna-oncall: I'm on it. seeing a spike starting ~1766661970. thanks for the ping.

sana: +1 oncall. what are the affected routes?

anna-oncall: quick kql from logs shows concentrated 502/504 on /v1/generate and /v1/chat for the eu-west and us-west frontends but origin failures are us-west-2 primary.

jamie: are we seeing high latency at the ingress or timeouts from upstreams?

anna-oncall: both. edge latency up, and origin (api-backend-v2 pool) showing backend timeouts and 502 responses. looks like connection resets to upstreams.

mike: rolling health from envoy metrics: 502s up to 28% p95 on the edge cluster for a span; 504s correlate with high backend latency > 10s.

kyle: any recent deploys/rollouts in us-west-2?

lisa: deploy bot shows a canary to api-backend-v2 around 1766661800 (small config for KV cache change).

anna-oncall: hold on patching that as suspected. can someone pin the canary? jamie, can you check the canary rollout and pause?

jamie: pausing canary now.

ops-bot: Deploy pause: api-backend-v2/rollout#canary paused by jamie at 1766662105.

anna-oncall: thanks. next: apply emergency circuit-breaker on edge for api-backend-v2 to reduce concurrent connections. we'll also enable routing fallback to api-backend-v1 for traffic above 60% error rate.

mike: applying cb rule to envoy on us-west-2 edge nodes now.

kyle: creating route rule: fallback -> api-backend-v1 with 10s cooldown.

anna-oncall: also reduce client retries at the LB layer to single attempt for /v1/generate to avoid request amplification.

lisa: setting retry_policy: max_retries=1 for generate path in ingress config.

cs-bot: Customer-impact update: initial telemetry shows increased error rate for all customers using streaming endpoints in us-west-2; estimated 12% of active sessions affected. Top impacted customers: acme-inc (prod), beta-platform (staging).

sana: are any enterprise customers hitting SLA? we need to notify CS if yes.

cs-bot: ACME-INC (account-id: acm-123) has >30% of requests failing during window; recommended immediate customer outreach.

anna-oncall: ok, designate a comms lead. sana please coordinate CS notification. here's a short blurb you can use: "We're investigating elevated 5xx errors impacting inference requests from the us-west-2 gateway. Engineers are mitigating with routing fallbacks and reduced retries; we will update at 15-min cadence."

sana: will do.

jamie: cb and fallback applied. seeing overall 502s drop to ~12% in 60s. p50 latency improving.

mike: backend metrics show worker OOMs spiking on api-backend-v2 pods before the canary pause. likely the KV change increased memory pressure under peak seq lengths.

anna-oncall: good catch. that maps to the logs: repeated "connection reset by peer" and kernel OOM messages on nodes host-*-usw2.

kyle: scaling up api-backend-v2 pool by +3 nodes as a short-term relief. triggering now.

ops-bot: Scaling action: api-backend-v2 scaled to desired=18 from=15 by kyle at 1766662178.

anna-oncall: also mark the canary as reverted and schedule a rollback of that config. jamie, please roll the canary out of the cluster.

jamie: reverting canary and redeploying stable config.

anna-oncall: monitoring. if error rate stays under 5% for 10m, we'll start customer updates and close pager. if not, escalate to infra lead.

mike: after scale + rollback, 502s down to 4.7% edge-wide in 3m. p95 latency back to normal ranges.

cs-bot: Update for comms: ACME-INC reached out via support. Sana posting initial note and scheduling customer update at +30m.

sana: posted to ACME-INC and to #customers with timeline and ETA.

anna-oncall: rolling postmortem checklist items: capture traces for 10m window, collect kernel OOM logs, annotate runbook steps we executed (pause canary, cb, fallback, scale, rollback). tagging infra and runtime teams for root cause.

kyle: filing follow-up ticket: RUNTIME-6782 "Investigate KV cache canary memory regression leading to OOMs on api-backend-v2" and linking logs/traces.

anna-oncall: thanks all. I'll leave the channel open for another 30m then hand back to oncall rotation. closing pager in 10m if metrics stable.

ops-bot: Pager closed by anna-oncall at 1766662302. Resolution: routing fallback + scale + rollback reduced 5xx rate to <5%. Follow-up ticket RUNTIME-6782 created.

mike: quick note — recommend we add an autoscaling policy tied to memory pressure for api-backend pools to avoid manual scale in future.

lisa: adding that to the ticket.

anna-oncall: great, thanks team. leaving notes in incident tracker and will create a short incident summary doc for the weekly postmortem review. :white_check_mark:"
